About us

A family shop that grew with Ganga

Twelve years on the same road, the same phone number, and thousands of households supplied.

Our story

1 Star Electronics started as a small mobile counter on the Sangaria–Sirsa Road with one simple rule: sell only what you would use yourself.

2 Word spread from Ganga to neighbouring villages. Mobiles came first, then televisions and coolers, then appliances, and finally a full furniture section for families setting up new homes.

3 Today three generations of families buy here — because the price on the tag is the price on the bill, and because we pick up the phone even after the sale.

Owner’s message

“If a customer has to call us twice for the same problem, we have failed. Come for the price, stay for the service.”

— Proprietor, Star Electronics Ganga

  • Honest pricing, always on the bill
  • Only authorised, genuine stock
  • After-sales support that answers the phone
  • Free delivery and setup in Ganga

Inside the store

In the community

We sponsor local school events, keep a service slot open every morning for elderly customers, and repair phones free of charge for the village panchayat office.
